subject: Enabling Case-Insensitive Domain Names on Shiny-Server

messages.author: de0353bdfec15530
messages.subject: Enabling Case-Insensitive Domain Names on Shiny-Server
parts:
Hi all.

Let's say you've configured a private shiny-server and have an app running on it.  The app is accessible when you type in the exact same string as that found in your site_dir, which is a directive specified in /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf.  The problem with this is that the app address is case-sensitive. 

Let's say you've chosen the default settings and have apps hosted in /srv/shiny-server.  If you have an app located in /srv/shiny-server/MyApp, if you enter 127.0.0.1/myapp, the address will not resolve.  What would you recommend to make the url more stable in terms of case-sensitivity?  I couldn't find anything in the admin guide.

Thanks!
